1925-04-01.head: Hebrew University Opened at Jerusalem
1925-04-01.body: The Hebrew University of Jerusalem has been opened at a gala ceremony attended by Lord Balfour, Lord Allenby, Mr Winston Churchill and Sir Herbert Samuel.

1925-04-01.head: Barotse King Abolishes Forced Labour
1925-04-01.body: Yeta III, King of Barotseland, has abolished the corvée, the last vestige of slavery in Northern Rhodesia.

1925-04-02.head: Alexandretta Autonomy Agreed by France, Turkey
1925-04-02.body: France and Turkey have agreed upon the autonomy of the district of Alexandretta.

1925-04-02.head: Irish Free State Merges Police Forces
1925-04-02.body: The Police Forces Amalgamation Act has come into effect, joining the Garda Síochána and the Dublin Metropolitan Police into a single national force.

1925-04-03.head: Ulster Unionists Hold Northern Ireland
1925-04-03.body: Lord Craigavon's Ulster Unionist Party has won 32 of the 52 seats in the elections for the Parliament of Northern Ireland.

1925-04-03.head: Britain Repeals Duty on German Goods
1925-04-03.body: The British Government has repealed the Reparation Recovery Act, which levied import duties on German goods to recover reparations payments.

1925-04-04.head: Hindenburg to Stand for German Presidency
1925-04-04.body: Field Marshal von Hindenburg has agreed to stand in the second round of the German presidential election, replacing Dr Karl Jarres as the candidate of the Right.

1925-04-04.head: Western Australia Rejects Prohibition
1925-04-04.body: Voters in Western Australia have rejected a proposal to ban the sale of beer and liquor by 65 per cent to 35 per cent.

1925-04-05.head: Belgian Election Ends in Deadlock
1925-04-05.body: Belgium has voted for its Chamber and Senate. The Catholic Party and the Labour Party have each won 78 seats in the Chamber.

1925-04-06.head: Film Shown Aboard London-Paris Air Liner
1925-04-06.body: Passengers on an Imperial Airways flight from London to Paris have watched the film The Lost World while in the air.

1925-04-06.head: Chicago Reporter Beaten by Capone Gang
1925-04-06.body: Mr Robert St. John, a newspaper reporter who exposed Al Capone's operations in Cicero, Illinois, has been severely beaten by Capone's men.

1925-04-07.head: Death of Patriarch Tikhon of Moscow
1925-04-07.body: Tikhon, Patriarch of Moscow and head of the Russian Orthodox Church, has died at the age of 60.

1925-04-07.head: French Chamber Votes for Women's Suffrage
1925-04-07.body: The French Chamber of Deputies has voted 389 to 140 to give women the vote, but the Senate has refused to take up the measure.

1925-04-08.head: Plan to Settle 450,000 Britons in Australia
1925-04-08.body: The Australian Government and the Colonial Office have announced a joint scheme of low-interest loans and training to help 450,000 British citizens settle in Australia.

1925-04-08.head: Night Landing on American Aircraft Carrier
1925-04-08.body: Lieutenant John D. Price has made the first planned night landing on an American aircraft carrier, bringing his biplane down on USS Langley off California.

1925-04-09.head: Two Killed in Damascus Protest Against Balfour
1925-04-09.body: Two people were killed and eleven wounded in Damascus when an Arab demonstration against Lord Balfour near his hotel turned into a violent clash with police.

1925-04-09.head: Trustee Act Receives Royal Assent
1925-04-09.body: King George has given royal assent to the Trustee Act, consolidating the law of trustees in England and Wales, to take effect on 1 January 1926.

1925-04-10.head: Balfour Hastily Leaves Damascus
1925-04-10.body: Lord Balfour has hastily left Damascus as Arab protests against his visit continued.

1925-04-10.head: Herriot Cabinet Falls in France
1925-04-10.body: M. Édouard Herriot and his Cabinet have resigned after losing a vote of confidence in the Senate by 156 votes to 132.

1925-04-10.head: Tsaritsyn Renamed Stalingrad
1925-04-10.body: The Russian city of Tsaritsyn has been renamed Stalingrad in honour of M. Joseph Stalin, for his part in its defence during the Civil War.

1925-04-11.head: Celtic Win the Scottish Cup
1925-04-11.body: Celtic defeated Dundee 2 to 1 before 75,317 spectators at Hampden Park, Glasgow, to win the Scottish Cup.

1925-04-11.head: Roosevelt Expedition Sails for Central Asia
1925-04-11.body: The James Simpson-Roosevelt Asiatic Expedition has sailed from New York aboard the Leviathan to collect wildlife in the Pamir and Tian Shan mountains.

1925-04-12.head: Abd el-Krim Attacks French in Morocco
1925-04-12.body: Riffian forces under Abd el-Krim have attacked French positions in Morocco, widening the Rif war.

1925-04-12.head: Metropolitan Peter to Lead Russian Church
1925-04-12.body: Metropolitan Peter of Krutitsy has been installed as head of the Russian Church on the day of Patriarch Tikhon's funeral in Moscow.

1925-04-12.head: France Diverts Boxer Indemnity to Chinese Railways
1925-04-12.body: Following the British example, France has agreed that its share of the Boxer indemnity should go to railway construction in China.

1925-04-13.head: Ford Begins Air Freight Service
1925-04-13.body: The Ford Air Transport Service has begun operations, flying 1,000 pounds of freight from Detroit to Chicago in a Stout all-metal aeroplane.

1925-04-13.head: Death of Elwood Haynes
1925-04-13.body: Mr Elwood Haynes, 67, the American pioneer of the motor car, has died.

1925-04-14.head: Tsar Boris Escapes Assassins' Bullets
1925-04-14.body: King Boris III of Bulgaria has escaped an attempt on his life when anarchists fired on his car. A servant and a museum director were killed.

1925-04-15.head: Haarmann Executed in Hanover
1925-04-15.body: Fritz Haarmann, convicted of murdering 24 boys, has been executed by beheading.

1925-04-15.head: Death of John Singer Sargent
1925-04-15.body: Mr John Singer Sargent, 69, the celebrated portrait painter, has died in London of heart disease.

1925-04-16.head: Sofia Cathedral Bombed During Funeral
1925-04-16.body: A bomb has wrecked St Nedelya Church in Sofia during a state funeral, killing and wounding hundreds. General Stefan Nerezov, Bulgarian Chief of Staff, is among the dead.

1925-04-17.head: Painlevé Forms New French Government
1925-04-17.body: M. Paul Painlevé has formed a government and become Prime Minister of France in succession to M. Herriot.

1925-04-18.head: Riots on Italian Stock Exchanges
1925-04-18.body: Rioting has broken out on Italian stock exchanges in protest at a new edict requiring 25 per cent cash payment for purchases of shares and bonds.

1925-04-18.head: International Amateur Radio Union Founded
1925-04-18.body: Wireless amateurs of many nations, meeting in Paris, have founded the International Amateur Radio Union.

1925-04-18.head: Death of Sir Rickman Godlee
1925-04-18.body: Sir Rickman Godlee, 76, the surgeon who in 1884 first removed a tumour from the human brain, has died.

1925-04-19.head: Former Maryland Governor Smith Dead
1925-04-19.body: Mr J. W. Smith, 80, formerly Governor of Maryland and United States Senator, has died.

1925-04-19.head: Colo-Colo Football Club Founded in Chile
1925-04-19.body: A new football club, Colo-Colo, has been founded at Santiago, Chile, by the player David Arellano.

1925-04-20.head: Warner Brothers Acquire Vitagraph
1925-04-20.body: Warner Brothers have purchased the Vitagraph film company, one of the oldest in America, from Mr Albert E. Smith.

1925-04-20.head: Death of Finnish Inventor Tigerstedt
1925-04-20.body: Mr Eric Tigerstedt, 37, the Finnish inventor called the Edison of Finland, has died of tuberculosis.

1925-04-21.head: Wahhabis Level Tombs at Medina
1925-04-21.body: Wahhabi authorities have demolished the domes and mausoleums of the Al-Baqi cemetery at Medina, including grave markers of the Prophet's family.

1925-04-21.head: Japanese Freighter Lost with All Hands
1925-04-21.body: The Japanese steamer Raifuku Maru, carrying wheat to Germany, has foundered in a storm off Nova Scotia with the loss of all 38 crew.

1925-04-21.head: De Pinedo Leaves Rome for Australia
1925-04-21.body: The Italian aviator Francesco de Pinedo has left Rome to fly to Australia and Tokyo and back, a journey of some 35,000 miles.

1925-04-22.head: Japan Enacts Peace Preservation Law
1925-04-22.body: Japan has enacted a Peace Preservation Law prohibiting associations that seek to alter the national polity.

1925-04-22.head: Saltair Pavilion Destroyed by Fire
1925-04-22.body: The Saltair pavilion, the celebrated bathing resort on the Great Salt Lake in Utah, has been destroyed by fire.

1925-04-23.head: Floyd Collins' Body Recovered from Cave
1925-04-23.body: The body of the Kentucky cave explorer Floyd Collins has been brought out of Sand Cave, nearly two months after he was trapped.

1925-04-23.head: Slavery Ended in Kano Royal Household
1925-04-23.body: On the death of Usman II, Emir of Kano, his successor Abdullahi Bayero has agreed to free the remaining slaves of the royal family.

1925-04-24.head: Poland and Czechoslovakia Settle Frontier
1925-04-24.body: Poland and Czechoslovakia have signed a border treaty at Warsaw, closing the dispute arbitrated by the League of Nations.

1925-04-24.head: Ex-Crown Prince Hopes for Monarchy
1925-04-24.body: The former German Crown Prince Wilhelm has said a victory for Field Marshal von Hindenburg in Sunday's election could restore the monarchy.

1925-04-24.head: Liner Conte Biancamano Launched
1925-04-24.body: The Italian ocean liner Conte Biancamano has been launched.

1925-04-25.head: Sheffield United Win the Cup
1925-04-25.body: Sheffield United defeated Cardiff City 1 to 0 in the Football Association Cup Final.

1925-04-25.head: Shamrock Rovers League of Ireland Champions
1925-04-25.body: Shamrock Rovers have finished first in the League of Ireland with 13 wins and 5 draws.

1925-04-26.head: Hindenburg Elected President of Germany
1925-04-26.body: Field Marshal Paul von Hindenburg has won the German presidential run-off with 14,655,641 votes against 13,751,605 for Dr Wilhelm Marx.

1925-04-26.head: Mosque Opened in Berlin
1925-04-26.body: A mosque designed by K. A. Herrmann has been opened for the Muslims of Berlin.

1925-04-26.head: Kafka's Novel Der Prozess Published
1925-04-26.body: Der Prozess, the last novel of the late Franz Kafka, has been published in Germany.

1925-04-27.head: French Aeroplanes Bomb the Rif
1925-04-27.body: The French air force has begun air raids against the Riffian forces in Morocco.

1925-04-27.head: Varna Bomb Plot Foiled in Bulgaria
1925-04-27.body: Bulgarian authorities say they have seized 400 pounds of explosives from conspirators planning to blow up public buildings in Varna.

1925-04-27.head: Man Murdered in Sheffield Gang Affray
1925-04-27.body: Mr William Plommer has been killed in a gang affray in Sheffield.

1925-04-28.head: Churchill Returns Britain to Gold Standard
1925-04-28.body: Mr Winston Churchill, Chancellor of the Exchequer, has announced Britain's return to the gold standard in presenting his Budget.

1925-04-28.head: Decorative Arts Exhibition Opens in Paris
1925-04-28.body: The International Exhibition of Modern Decorative and Industrial Arts has been inaugurated in Paris before 4,000 guests.

1925-04-28.head: Death of Sir P. Theagaraya Chetty
1925-04-28.body: Sir P. Theagaraya Chetty, 73, chairman of the South Indian Liberal Federation, has died at Madras.

1925-04-29.head: Grindell Matthews Announces Light-Ray Organ
1925-04-29.body: The English inventor Mr Grindell Matthews says he is completing his luminaphone, a machine worked by light rays that plays like a pipe organ.

1925-04-29.head: Brooklyn Club Owner McKeever Dead
1925-04-29.body: Mr Ed McKeever, 56, part owner of the Brooklyn baseball club, has died of influenza, contracted at the funeral of Mr Charles Ebbets.

1925-04-30.head: Motor Show Opens in Melbourne
1925-04-30.body: The first Australian International Motor Show has been held in Melbourne.

1925-05-01.head: Cyprus Becomes a Crown Colony
1925-05-01.body: Cyprus has become a British Crown Colony.

1925-05-01.head: RAF Ends Waziristan Air Campaign
1925-05-01.body: The Royal Air Force bombing campaign against the Mahsud tribe in South Waziristan has ended after 53 days.

1925-05-01.head: Croce Issues Anti-Fascist Manifesto
1925-05-01.body: Signor Benedetto Croce's Manifesto of the Anti-Fascist Intellectuals has been published in the Rome newspaper Il Mondo.

1925-05-02.head: Yugoslav King Interns His Brother
1925-05-02.body: King Alexander of Yugoslavia has signed a decree interning his brother, Prince George, as mentally incompetent.

1925-05-02.head: Republicans Sweep Bolivian Elections
1925-05-02.body: The Republican Party has won all 70 seats in the Bolivian Chamber, and José Cabino Villanueva has been elected President.

1925-05-02.head: Death of Astronomer Johann Palisa
1925-05-02.body: Herr Johann Palisa, 76, the Austrian astronomer and discoverer of many minor planets, has died in Vienna.

1925-05-03.head: Coolidge Speaks at Jewish Centre Ceremony
1925-05-03.body: President Coolidge has addressed the ground-breaking ceremony of the Jewish Community Center in Washington, speaking on the Jewish faith.

1925-05-04.head: Arms Traffic Conference Opens at Geneva
1925-05-04.body: An international conference has opened at Geneva seeking agreement on limiting the traffic in arms.

1925-05-04.head: Swains Island Annexed by United States
1925-05-04.body: Swains Island, with about 100 inhabitants, has been annexed by the United States as part of American Samoa.

1925-05-05.head: Japan Passes General Election Law
1925-05-05.body: The Japanese Diet has passed a General Election Law.

1925-05-05.head: Tennessee Teacher Held Over Evolution
1925-05-05.body: Mr John T. Scopes, a biology teacher at Dayton, Tennessee, has been arrested for teaching evolution in violation of a new state law.

1925-05-06.head: Schoolboys Kill Teacher in Wilno
1925-05-06.body: Two schoolboys attacked their teachers at a school in Wilno, Poland. A teacher and two pupils were killed, and nine pupils and the principal wounded.

1925-05-06.head: Romania Regulates Orthodox Church
1925-05-06.body: Romania has passed a statute on the organisation of the Romanian Orthodox Church.

1925-05-07.head: Death of Lord Leverhulme
1925-05-07.body: Lord Leverhulme, 73, the soap manufacturer, philanthropist and politician, has died.

1925-05-07.head: Death of Admiral Sturdee
1925-05-07.body: Admiral of the Fleet Sir Doveton Sturdee, 65, victor of the Falkland Islands battle of 1914, has died.

1925-05-08.head: Afrikaans Made Official in South Africa
1925-05-08.body: The South African Parliament has passed the Official Languages Act, placing Afrikaans on an equal footing with English.

1925-05-08.head: Macedonian Leader Shot in Vienna Theatre
1925-05-08.body: Todor Panitsa, the Macedonian revolutionary, has been shot dead at the Vienna Burgtheater by Mencha Karnicheva in revenge for IMRO murders.

1925-05-08.head: Mississippi Steamboat Capsizes, 23 Drowned
1925-05-08.body: The steamboat M. E. Norman capsized on the Mississippi near Memphis, drowning 23. A local man, Tom Lee, rescued 32.

1925-05-09.head: Tungus Revolt Against Soviets Ends
1925-05-09.body: The Tungus secessionist rising in Yakutia has ended with the surrender of its leader, Mikhail Artemyev, in exchange for an amnesty.

1925-05-09.head: Keats House Opened to Public
1925-05-09.body: The Hampstead house of the poet John Keats has been opened to the public.

1925-05-10.head: New Zealand Premier Massey Dead
1925-05-10.body: Mr William Massey, Prime Minister of New Zealand since 1912, has died. Sir Francis Bell succeeds him.

1925-05-10.head: Death of Alexandru Marghiloman
1925-05-10.body: M. Alexandru Marghiloman, 71, briefly Prime Minister of Romania in 1918, has died.

1925-05-11.head: Étoile Sportive du Sahel Founded
1925-05-11.body: A new football club, Étoile Sportive du Sahel, has been founded at Sousse in Tunisia.

1925-05-12.head: Hindenburg Sworn in as President
1925-05-12.body: Field Marshal von Hindenburg has been sworn in as President of Germany for a seven-year term, calling for national unity.

1925-05-12.head: Death of General Mangin
1925-05-12.body: General Charles Mangin, 58, the French commander of the Great War, has died.

1925-05-12.head: Bryan to Prosecute Tennessee Teacher
1925-05-12.body: Mr William Jennings Bryan has agreed to assist the prosecution in the case of Mr John Scopes.

1925-05-13.head: Death of Lord Milner
1925-05-13.body: Viscount Milner, 71, former High Commissioner for South Africa and Colonial Secretary, has died.

1925-05-13.head: Gold Standard Act Receives Royal Assent
1925-05-13.body: The King has given royal assent to the Gold Standard Act, formally restoring Britain to gold.

1925-05-13.head: Soviets Create Uzbek and Turkmen Republics
1925-05-13.body: The Uzbek and Turkmen Soviet Socialist Republics have been raised to the status of full republics of the Soviet Union.

1925-05-14.head: French Take Bibane Height in Rif
1925-05-14.body: French forces have captured the Bibane height in the fighting against Abd el-Krim.

1925-05-14.head: Death of Sir H. Rider Haggard
1925-05-14.body: Sir H. Rider Haggard, 68, author of King Solomon's Mines and She, has died.

1925-05-14.head: Mrs Woolf's New Novel Published
1925-05-14.body: Mrs Dalloway, a new novel by Virginia Woolf, has been published in London.

1925-05-15.head: New Arabic Communist Newspaper Appears
1925-05-15.body: Al-Insaniyyah, the first Arabic communist newspaper, has been founded.

1925-05-15.head: Japanese Press Protests Pearl Harbour Plans
1925-05-15.body: Japanese newspapers have denounced American plans to strengthen the naval base at Pearl Harbour.

1925-05-15.head: Coolidge Refuses Navy for Prohibition
1925-05-15.body: President Coolidge has rejected a plan by Mr Wayne Wheeler to use the Navy to enforce the Volstead Act.

1925-05-16.head: Monteverdi Opera Revived in Paris
1925-05-16.body: Monteverdi's opera Il ritorno d'Ulisse in patria has been given its first modern performance in Paris.

1925-05-16.head: Senator Selden Spencer Dead
1925-05-16.body: Senator Selden P. Spencer, 62, of Missouri, has died after an operation.

1925-05-17.head: Thérèse of Lisieux Proclaimed a Saint
1925-05-17.body: Pope Pius XI has canonised Thérèse of Lisieux, the French Carmelite nun who died in 1897.

1925-05-17.head: 15,000 Protest Against Bratianu in Bucharest
1925-05-17.body: About 15,000 people have demonstrated in Bucharest against the government of M. Ionel Brătianu.

1925-05-18.head: Martial Law Ended in Spain
1925-05-18.body: King Alfonso XIII has signed a decree ending the martial law imposed in Spain in September 1923.

1925-05-19.head: Spain Returns to Ordinary Law
1925-05-19.body: Spain has returned to ordinary law under the King's decree ending the martial law in force since the coup of September 1923.
1925-05-19.note: Page lists no events for 19 May; item reports the 18 May decree as carried in 19 May newspapers.

1925-05-20.head: Machado Sworn in as President of Cuba
1925-05-20.body: General Gerardo Machado has been sworn in as President of Cuba following his election last November.

1925-05-20.head: Death of Sir Joseph Howard
1925-05-20.body: Sir Joseph Howard, 62, the first Prime Minister of Malta, has died.

1925-05-20.head: Floods on the Murrumbidgee Kill Eight
1925-05-20.body: Floods on the Murrumbidgee River in New South Wales have killed eight people.

1925-05-21.head: Amundsen Takes Off for the North Pole
1925-05-21.body: Captain Roald Amundsen's two seaplanes, N24 and N25, have taken off from Spitsbergen in an attempt to fly to the North Pole.

1925-05-21.head: Ontario Allows Stronger Beer
1925-05-21.body: Beer of 4.4 per cent strength has gone on sale legally in Ontario, drawing visitors from neighbouring American states.

1925-05-22.head: Ecumenical Patriarch Constantine VI Resigns
1925-05-22.body: Constantine VI has resigned as Ecumenical Patriarch of Constantinople.

1925-05-22.head: Death of Lord Ypres
1925-05-22.body: Field Marshal the Earl of Ypres, 72, who commanded the British Expeditionary Force in 1914, has died.

1925-05-23.head: Earthquake Devastates Toyooka District, Japan
1925-05-23.body: A severe earthquake has struck western Japan around Toyooka, killing some 400 people and destroying thousands of buildings.

1925-05-23.head: Death of Sir Edward Hulton
1925-05-23.body: Sir Edward Hulton, 56, the newspaper proprietor and racehorse owner, has died.

1925-05-24.head: Swiss Reject Old Age Insurance Plan
1925-05-24.body: Swiss voters have overwhelmingly rejected the Rothenberger initiative for retirement insurance.

1925-05-24.head: Komsomolskaya Pravda First Issue
1925-05-24.body: The Soviet newspaper Komsomolskaya Pravda, for members of the Communist youth league, has published its first issue.

1925-05-25.head: New Star Blazes in Southern Sky
1925-05-25.body: A bright new star has been discovered in the constellation Pictor by Mr Robert Watson, a telegraph operator and amateur astronomer.

1925-05-25.head: Scopes Indicted by Tennessee Grand Jury
1925-05-25.body: Mr John Scopes has been indicted by the Rhea County grand jury for violating Tennessee's law against teaching evolution.

1925-05-26.head: Rescue Plans for Amundsen Party
1925-05-26.body: Plans are being drawn up for an international rescue expedition for Captain Amundsen's party, missing for five days.

1925-05-26.head: Chicago Gangster Angelo Genna Killed
1925-05-26.body: Angelo Genna, a Chicago gang leader, has been shot dead by rival gunmen after a car chase.

1925-05-26.head: Mongolian Air Force Established
1925-05-26.body: An air force has been activated in the Mongolian People's Republic.

1925-05-27.head: Mine Explosion Kills 53 in North Carolina
1925-05-27.body: An explosion at the Coal Glen mine near Farmville, North Carolina, has killed 53 miners.

1925-05-27.head: Coates Chosen to Lead New Zealand
1925-05-27.body: Mr Gordon Coates has been elected leader of New Zealand's Reform Party, defeating Mr William Nosworthy.

1925-05-28.head: Home Secretary Bars Subversive Aliens
1925-05-28.body: The Home Secretary, Sir William Joynson-Hicks, has barred aliens engaged in subversive activities from the United Kingdom.

1925-05-29.head: Cobham Flies Light Aeroplane to Switzerland
1925-05-29.body: Mr Alan Cobham has set a record for a non-stop light aeroplane flight, flying a de Havilland Moth to Switzerland.

1925-05-29.head: Colonel Fawcett Last Heard of in Brazil
1925-05-29.body: Colonel Percy Fawcett has sent his last message from the Brazilian interior, where he is seeking a lost city in the Amazon.

1925-05-30.head: Shanghai Police Fire on Demonstrators
1925-05-30.body: Shanghai Municipal Police have opened fire on students protesting against the unequal treaties, causing an international outcry.

1925-05-30.head: Coates Becomes Prime Minister of New Zealand
1925-05-30.body: Mr Gordon Coates has taken office as Prime Minister of New Zealand.

1925-05-30.head: De Paolo Wins Indianapolis Race
1925-05-30.body: Peter DePaolo has won the Indianapolis 500-mile race, the first driver to finish the course in under five hours.

1925-05-31.head: Death of Composer John Palm
1925-05-31.body: Mr John Palm, 39, the Curaçao composer, has died of tuberculosis.

1925-05-31.head: Unrest Spreads in Shanghai After Shooting
1925-05-31.body: Strikes and protests have followed the shooting of Chinese demonstrators by the Shanghai Municipal Police.
1925-05-31.note: No major world event listed for 31 May; carries the ongoing Shanghai story from 30 May.

1925-06-01.head: Tangier International Zone Established
1925-06-01.body: The Tangier International Zone has been formally established in Morocco.

1925-06-01.head: Death of Former Vice-President Marshall
1925-06-01.body: Mr Thomas R. Marshall, 71, Vice-President of the United States from 1913 to 1921, has died of a heart attack.

1925-06-01.head: Death of Lucien Guitry
1925-06-01.body: M. Lucien Guitry, 64, the French actor, has died.

1925-06-02.head: Davar Begins Publication in Palestine
1925-06-02.body: The workers' newspaper Davar has begun publication in Palestine.

1925-06-02.head: Canada Claims Arctic to the Pole
1925-06-02.body: Mr Charles Stewart, Minister of the Interior, has told the Canadian Commons that Canada claims all land between Alaska and Greenland up to the North Pole.

1925-06-02.head: Orteig Renews New York-Paris Flight Prize
1925-06-02.body: Mr Raymond Orteig has renewed his $25,000 prize for the first non-stop aeroplane flight between New York and Paris.

1925-06-03.head: Turkish Opposition Party Ordered Closed
1925-06-03.body: The Progressive Republican Party of Kâzım Karabekir Pasha has been ordered closed by an Independence Tribunal, accused of supporting the religious customs behind the Sheikh Said rising.

1925-06-03.head: Philippine Elections Held
1925-06-03.body: Elections have been held for the Philippine House of Representatives and eleven Senate seats.

1925-06-03.head: Goodyear Launches Airship Pilgrim
1925-06-03.body: The Goodyear Tire and Rubber Company of Akron has launched a non-rigid airship, the Pilgrim.

1925-06-04.head: Ohio Man Shoots Eight of Family
1925-06-04.body: Floyd Russel, 43, has shot dead eight members of his family at Hamilton, Ohio.

1925-06-04.head: Indian Nationalist V. V. S. Aiyar Drowned
1925-06-04.body: Mr V. V. S. Aiyar, 44, the Tamil nationalist and writer, has drowned in a waterfall of the Thamirabarani river.

1925-06-05.head: Karabekir Pasha and 82 Others Arrested
1925-06-05.body: Kâzım Karabekir Pasha and 82 other members of the dissolved Progressive Republican Party have been arrested in Turkey.

1925-06-05.head: Maharaja of Gwalior Dead
1925-06-05.body: Madho Rao Scindia, Maharaja of Gwalior, has died and is succeeded by his son Jiwajirao.

1925-06-05.head: Aristotle University Founded at Salonica
1925-06-05.body: The Greek Government has founded a university at Salonica, named after Aristotle.

1925-06-06.head: Sarrail Turns Away Druze Delegation
1925-06-06.body: General Sarrail, High Commissioner in the Levant, has ordered a Druze delegation to leave Beirut or face arrest and exile to Palmyra.

1925-06-06.head: Chrysler Corporation Formed
1925-06-06.body: Mr Walter P. Chrysler has incorporated the Chrysler Corporation after acquiring the assets of the Maxwell Motor Company.

1925-06-07.head: Newfoundland Memorial Unveiled at Beaumont-Hamel
1925-06-07.body: A memorial to the Newfoundland soldiers who fell at the Somme in July 1916 has been unveiled at Beaumont-Hamel.

1925-06-07.head: Norway Searches for Amundsen
1925-06-07.body: Norway has sent two aeroplanes and two steamships to search for the Amundsen polar expedition, missing for over two weeks.

1925-06-08.head: Hay Fever Opens in London
1925-06-08.body: Mr Noël Coward's comedy Hay Fever has opened at the Ambassadors Theatre.

1925-06-08.head: U.S. Supreme Court Rules in Gitlow Case
1925-06-08.body: The United States Supreme Court has upheld a New York law against advocating the overthrow of government, while applying free speech protections to the states.

1925-06-09.head: Train Falls from Bridge in Queensland
1925-06-09.body: Ten people were killed and 48 injured when a train left a trestle bridge at Traveston, Queensland.

1925-06-09.head: American Heat Wave Eases
1925-06-09.body: The heat wave in the United States has eased after an estimated 500 deaths.

1925-06-10.head: United Church of Canada Formed
1925-06-10.body: The Methodist, Congregational and most Presbyterian churches of Canada have united as the United Church of Canada at a meeting in Toronto.

1925-06-10.head: Seven Killed in Yorkshire Derailment
1925-06-10.body: Seven people were killed when a train derailed near Hebden, Yorkshire, owing to worn brake linings.

1925-06-11.head: China and Japan Sign Korean Agreement
1925-06-11.body: China and Japan have signed a treaty under which China agrees to remove Korean immigrants from its north-eastern provinces.

1925-06-11.head: Miner Shot Dead in Nova Scotia Riot
1925-06-11.body: Company guards fired into a crowd of 3,000 miners and families at New Waterford, Nova Scotia, killing miner William Davis.

1925-06-12.head: Painlevé Flies to Morocco
1925-06-12.body: M. Painlevé, the French Prime Minister, has flown to Morocco to inspect the Rif front.

1925-06-12.head: Calles Threatens Foreign Oil Fields
1925-06-12.body: President Calles has threatened to seize foreign oil fields in Mexico; Mr Kellogg has warned the United States may break off relations.

1925-06-13.head: Jenkins Transmits Pictures by Wireless
1925-06-13.body: Mr C. Francis Jenkins has transmitted moving silhouette pictures with sound by wireless five miles to his Washington laboratory.

1925-06-13.head: Two Chicago Police Killed in Gun Battle
1925-06-13.body: Two Chicago policemen were killed in a gun battle with the Genna gang; Mike Genna was shot dead and two gunmen captured.

1925-06-14.head: Barcelona Club Closed Over Anthem Jeers
1925-06-14.body: FC Barcelona has been fined and its ground closed for six months after spectators jeered the Spanish national anthem.

1925-06-14.head: Kahanamoku Saves Eight off Newport Beach
1925-06-14.body: Mr Duke Kahanamoku, the Olympic swimmer, rescued eight people when the fishing yacht Thelma capsized off Newport Beach, California. Five were drowned.

1925-06-14.head: New Objectivity Exhibition in Mannheim
1925-06-14.body: An exhibition of the Neue Sachlichkeit movement, with works by Grosz, Dix and Beckmann, has opened in Mannheim.

1925-06-15.head: Amundsen Party Leaves Ice in Seaplane
1925-06-15.body: The Amundsen polar party, stranded since 22 May, has taken off in the seaplane N25 after cutting a runway in the ice.

1925-06-16.head: Amundsen Safe at Spitsbergen
1925-06-16.body: Captain Roald Amundsen and his crew have landed safely near Nordaustlandet, Spitsbergen.

1925-06-16.head: Death of Chittaranjan Das
1925-06-16.body: Mr C. R. Das, 54, the Bengal leader of the Indian nationalist movement, has died.

1925-06-16.head: 47 Killed in New Jersey Train Wreck
1925-06-16.body: A derailment near Hackettstown, New Jersey, has killed 47 people bound for Germany.

1925-06-17.head: Geneva Protocol Bans Gas Warfare
1925-06-17.body: Thirty-eight nations have signed a protocol at Geneva prohibiting the use of poison gas and bacteriological weapons in war.

1925-06-17.head: Egyptian Tomb Opened in Vienna
1925-06-17.body: The mastaba of Kaninisut, an ancient Egyptian tomb, has been opened to the public at the Kunsthistorisches Museum in Vienna after twelve years of reassembly.

1925-06-17.head: Poullet Becomes Belgian Prime Minister
1925-06-17.body: Viscount Prosper Poullet has become Prime Minister of Belgium after the Socialists voted 40 to 26 to join a coalition.

1925-06-18.head: Senator La Follette Dead
1925-06-18.body: Senator Robert M. La Follette of Wisconsin, 70, Progressive candidate for President last year, has died.

1925-06-18.head: German Court Upholds Coburg Ducal Lands
1925-06-18.body: The Reichsgericht has struck down a law confiscating the lands of the Dukes of Saxe-Coburg and Gotha as unconstitutional.

1925-06-19.head: Bank Robber Bridgewater Taken in Indianapolis
1925-06-19.body: Everett Bridgewater and accomplices have been arrested in Indianapolis after their sixth armed robbery.

1925-06-19.head: Death of Japan's Scouting Founder
1925-06-19.body: Mr Hiroshi Koshiba, 40, founder of the first boy scout group in Japan, has died.

1925-06-20.head: Mussolini Opens Battle for Grain
1925-06-20.body: Signor Mussolini has launched a campaign to increase Italian wheat production and make the country self-sufficient in grain.

1925-06-20.head: Peru's First Radio Station on the Air
1925-06-20.body: Peru's first broadcasting station, OAX, has begun transmitting from Lima.

1925-06-21.head: Death of Peter H. Clark
1925-06-21.body: Mr Peter H. Clark, the American educator and Socialist politician, has died.

1925-06-21.head: Death of Organ Designer Audsley
1925-06-21.body: Mr George Ashdown Audsley, 86, designer of the Wanamaker organ, has died.

1925-06-22.head: Fascist Congress Closes in Rome
1925-06-22.body: The National Fascist Party congress has closed in Rome. Signor Farinacci was confirmed as secretary, and Signor Mussolini spoke of a totalitarian will.

1925-06-22.head: Death of Professor Felix Klein
1925-06-22.body: Professor Felix Klein, 76, the German mathematician, has died.

1925-06-23.head: British Troops Fire into Canton
1925-06-23.body: British troops firing from Shameen Island into Canton have killed 52 and wounded 117 amid the Canton-Hong Kong strike.

1925-06-23.head: Soviets Create Lenin Prize
1925-06-23.body: The Soviet Union has created a Lenin Prize for achievement in science, literature, the arts and technology.

1925-06-23.head: Irish Free State Holds Local Elections
1925-06-23.body: The Irish Free State has held its first local elections since independence.

1925-06-24.head: York Minster Window for Women War Dead
1925-06-24.body: The Five Sisters window in York Minster has been dedicated to women who lost their lives in service during the Great War.

1925-06-24.head: United States and Hungary Sign Treaty
1925-06-24.body: The United States and Hungary have signed a Treaty of Friendship, Commerce and Consular Rights.

1925-06-25.head: Pangalos Seizes Power in Greece
1925-06-25.body: General Theodoros Pangalos has led a bloodless coup d'état against the Greek Government.

1925-06-26.head: Pangalos Named Greek Prime Minister
1925-06-26.body: President Kountouriotis has dismissed M. Michalakopoulos and appointed General Pangalos Prime Minister after the military takeover.

1925-06-26.head: New Oba Elected in Lagos
1925-06-26.body: Ibikunle Akitoye has been elected Oba of Lagos in place of the deposed Eshugbayi Eleko.

1925-06-26.head: Chaplin's The Gold Rush Opens
1925-06-26.body: Mr Charles Chaplin's film The Gold Rush has had its première at Grauman's Egyptian Theatre, Hollywood.

1925-06-27.head: Earthquake Shakes Montana
1925-06-27.body: An earthquake has struck near Townsend, Montana, causing damage estimated at $150,000 but no casualties.

1925-06-27.head: German Railwaymen's Unions Merge
1925-06-27.body: Two German railway unions have merged into a United Union of German Railway Workers with nearly 200,000 members.

1925-06-28.head: Sheikh Said Sentenced to Death
1925-06-28.body: The Independence Tribunal at Diyarbekir has sentenced Sheikh Said and 46 others to death for the Kurdish rising.

1925-06-28.head: Albania Cedes St Naum to Yugoslavia
1925-06-28.body: Albania has ceded the monastery of St Naum to Yugoslavia, receiving the village of Starovo in exchange.

1925-06-29.head: Earthquake Wrecks Santa Barbara
1925-06-29.body: An earthquake has killed 13 people in Santa Barbara, California, and caused at least $8,000,000 in damage.

1925-06-29.head: Death of Christian Michelsen
1925-06-29.body: Mr Christian Michelsen, 68, first Prime Minister of independent Norway, has died.

1925-06-29.head: Stockholm's Svenska Teatern Burned
1925-06-29.body: The Svenska Teatern in Stockholm has been destroyed by fire.

1925-06-30.head: Jenkins Patents Wireless Picture System
1925-06-30.body: Mr C. Francis Jenkins has been granted a United States patent for transmitting pictures by wireless.

1925-06-30.head: Helen Keller Addresses Lions Convention
1925-06-30.body: The Lions Clubs have adopted work for the blind after an address by Miss Helen Keller at Cedar Point, Ohio.

1925-06-30.head: Mrs Rogers Wins Husband's Seat
1925-06-30.body: Mrs Edith Nourse Rogers has defeated Mr Eugene Foss to succeed her late husband as Representative for Massachusetts.
